name: agent-forge
description: Codex workflow plugin for user-controlled, composable multi-agent orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Agent Forge provides Codex-compatible workflow skills for user-controlled, low-intrusion, composable multi-agent orchestration. Its current Write Plan skill turns explicit planning requests into decision-complete local Markdown plans before execution, using non-mutating exploration and plan-changing questions to keep implementation choices clear.
defaultPrompt: $write-plan "Create a decision-complete plan for this feature"
$write-plan "Plan this migration and use official sources where needed"
$write-plan "Write an implementation plan for this release"
